mapper.update: UPDATE sys_tenant SET used_count_text = used_count_text + 1, used_annual_text = used_annual_text + 1 WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND ai_enabled = 1 AND used_count_text < monthly_quota_text AND used_annual_text < annual_quota_text

UPDATE sys_tenant SET used_count_voice = used_count_voice + 1, used_annual_voice = used_annual_voice + 1 WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND voice_enabled = 1 AND used_count_voice < monthly_quota_voice AND used_annual_voice < annual_quota_voice
UPDATE sys_tenant SET used_count_text = GREATEST(used_count_text - 1, 0), used_annual_text = GREATEST(used_annual_text - 1, 0) WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId}
UPDATE sys_tenant SET used_count_voice = GREATEST(used_count_voice - 1, 0), used_annual_voice = GREATEST(used_annual_voice - 1, 0) WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId}
UPDATE sys_tenant SET used_count_text = 0, used_count_voice = 0, used_count_ocr = 0, quota_reset_date = NOW() WHERE del_flag = '0'
UPDATE sys_tenant SET used_annual_text = 0, used_annual_voice = 0, used_annual_ocr = 0, quota_annual_reset_date = NOW() WHERE del_flag = '0'
UPDATE sys_tenant SET ai_points = ai_points + #{amount}, ai_points_total_used = GREATEST(ai_points_total_used - #{amount}, 0) WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId}
